core.gain_scope: Only four CA2 inhibitory-to-pyramidal connections. All other exported weights retained.
core.reversal_scope: Simulator-wide GABAa reversal, including CA2 and CA1 interneuron synapses.
core.calibration_status: Phenomenological inhibitory multiplier fitted to published single-pulse CA3 response. Reversal estimated from recipe, not measured EGABA. Fit is not validation.

CA1.boundary: Feedforward target assay; no CA1 pyramidal feedback, no upstream feedback, no explicit learning.
CA1.output_control: CA2 pyramidal replay only; identical four inhibitory streams and CA3 stream across conditions.

stimulus_definition.status: Prospective stimulus definition; execution waits for physiology/numerical assessment; model configuration not yet frozen
stimulus_definition.purpose: Synthetic identity transfer; no social-memory or learning claim
stimulus_definition.state: Every trial starts a new simulator process, resetting membrane, synapse and plasticity states. Fixed connectivity seed within each replicate.
stimulus_definition.primary_readout: CA1 128 targets: four50ms bins of cell spike counts; nearest-class-centroid Euclidean classifier trained only on designated training trials separately per context. Fixed classifier, no tuning. Balanced held-out accuracy; equal distance earns0.5.
controls: Deleted CA2 pyramidal output, keeping all other input streams fixed
Independently permuted CA2 pyramidal neuron IDs per reset trial, preserving every spike time and cell train up to ID remapping
stimulus_definition.secondary_readout: Aggregate population-count features using identical split and classifier. Report comparison without choosing the better decoder as primary.
stimulus_definition.uncertainty: Paired effects computed per network seed; seeds are model replicates, not animals. Five seeds give exploratory uncertainty, not population-level biological significance.
stimulus_definition.null: Balanced label permutations within context and split, fixed random seed, 1000 permutations for aggregate primary accuracy. Retain chance/no-response outcomes.
stimulus_definition.secondary_voltage_readout: CA1 first128 cells: mean membrane voltage in the same four50ms windows, minus each cell baseline mean40-49ms; same predetermined training/test split and centroid classifier. Report as subthreshold/state information, not spike transmission. No tuning and no selecting the better decoder as primary.
stimulus_definition.positive_control: Input-identity decoding must be perfect for noiseless prescribed cell-pattern counts; identical total spike counts must give chance under aggregate input-count features. This checks stimulus labels and readout calculations, not biological validity.

excluded_attempts: Original unchanged model: poor CA3 inhibition
Readout20vs40: one basket count comparison failed5%; final precision40vs80passes
protocol.interpretation: Confirmatory relative to frozen synthetic-task model and independent connectivity seeds. Biological interpretation remains exploratory and conditional on calibration, source defaults and incomplete circuitry. No claim of social memory or validated real CA2 function.
required_after_execution: Verify all80core trials and240matched readout runs with exact input delivery and finite complete recording.
Evaluate held-out primary spike decoder, secondary voltage decoder and input-positive control; retain null outcomes.
Report paired effects per five independent network seeds and uncertainty.
Test inhibitory-reversal, fitted-gain, numerical and default synaptic-parameter sensitivity.
Deliver inspectable configurations, analysis, scientific figures and bounded conclusion.

intact_minus_blocked.note: Exact five-seed bootstrap distribution; model-network uncertainty only, not uncertainty across animals.

intact_minus_scrambled.note: Exact five-seed bootstrap distribution; model-network uncertainty only, not uncertainty across animals.

intact.note: Balanced label permutations within network, context and split; no multiple-comparison adjustment. Primary intervention evidence is paired seed effects, not these diagnostic p values.

blocked.note: Balanced label permutations within network, context and split; no multiple-comparison adjustment. Primary intervention evidence is paired seed effects, not these diagnostic p values.

scrambled.note: Balanced label permutations within network, context and split; no multiple-comparison adjustment. Primary intervention evidence is paired seed effects, not these diagnostic p values.

limits: Synthetic identities and random connectivity do not model familiarity, learning, or animal behavior.
CA1 is a feedforward sample with no pyramidal feedback.
CA2 intervention changes only pyramidal output; all inhibitory streams and direct CA3 input are preserved.
Reversal and inhibitory gain include assumptions and calibration; results are conditional on this revised model.
Five model networks do not establish CA2 function in animals.
No decoder tuning; trial split predetermined before outcomes.
